verdict.rationale: Spline documents a Code API for web and a Real-time API, so an API-reference axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Prose docs for the Code API are ordinary documentation, not an interactive reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
